description: Writing rules for Raising Talents. See section 19 of docs/DESIGN.md. Add phrases here; the CI check reads this file.

bannedCharacters.name: em dash
bannedCharacters.fix: Use a full stop, comma, colon or brackets.

bannedCharacters.name: en dash
bannedCharacters.fix: Use 'to' for ranges, or a hyphen inside a word.

bannedPatterns.name: double hyphen used as a dash
bannedPatterns.fix: Use a full stop, comma, colon or brackets.
